caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted figure of a seated dog, rendered in varying shades of brown and gray. The dog is facing forward with its body slightly angled to its left, and it has a rounded head with large circular eyes, a short snout, and a closed mouth. The dog is adorned with a collar that has a small round tag hanging from it. The surface of the dog's body is decorated with a regular pattern of elongated oval shapes, suggesting a textured or patterned coat. The dog’s tail wraps around its haunch, and there is a hollowed section where the front leg bends, adding depth to the composition. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery, and the drawing is signed "Richard Barnett" in the lower right corner.
title: Door Stop
